title: Maintaining Correct Drain Pipe Slope to Prevent Clogs
description: Maintaining the proper slope on horizontal drainage pipes is critical for self-scouring action, ensuring liquids and solids flow together effectively. If pitch is too flat, water slows down and leaves solids behind to accumulate. If pitch is overly steep, water can outrun solid waste. Over time, inadequate pipe support can cause sags or 'bellies' where standing water collects. Preventative maintenance includes inspecting pipe hangers for proper spacing and using a torpedo level to confirm consistent pitch, preventing chronic blockages and sediment build-up along the drainage line.

Maintaining Correct Drain Pipe Slope to Prevent Clogs

Maintaining the proper slope on horizontal drainage pipes is critical for self-scouring action, ensuring liquids and solids flow together effectively. If pitch is too flat, water slows down and leaves solids behind to accumulate. If pitch is overly steep, water can outrun solid waste. Over time, inadequate pipe support can cause sags or 'bellies' where standing water collects. Preventative maintenance includes inspecting pipe hangers for proper spacing and using a torpedo level to confirm consistent pitch, preventing chronic blockages and sediment build-up along the drainage line.
